args.title: Fix trailing carriage return handling in src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In src/ingest/parser.ts, trailing empty line removal fails on files with carriage returns (\r\n) because they leave a trailing carriage return (\r) rather than an empty string, causing assertShape to fail. Update the parser to correctly check for empty lines (e.g. line.trim() === '') or strip trailing blank lines properly.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parser in src/ingest/parser.ts fails to correctly strip trailing empty lines when files use carriage returns (\r\n), leaving a trailing \r that causes assertShape to fail. We should check whether a line is empty (such as via line.trim() === '') or ensure trailing blank lines are correctly stripped before parsing.
